40 days with no food. Then the devil showed up. 😳 Matthew 4:1-11

Right after His baptism, Jesus was led into the wilderness. Three temptations: stones into bread, jump from the temple, bow down for all the kingdoms of the world. Three answers, every one of them “It is written.” “Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God” (Matthew 4:4).

Which verse do you hold onto when you're tempted? 👇

The sea in front. Pharaoh's army behind. Nowhere to run. 🌊 Exodus 14

Israel panicked. Moses said, “Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord” (Exodus 14:13). Then a strong east wind blew all night, the waters divided, and they walked through the middle of the sea on dry ground.

What's your Red Sea right now? Just one word 👇

Don't let the holidays steal your quiet time. 🦃📖

5 rules for Thanksgiving break: beat the house awake. Read one chapter, that's it. Bible first, phone second. Read it with someone, then write 3 things you're thankful for. Check what stuck. “In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you” (1 Thessalonians 5:18).

Which rule is hardest over the holidays? Comment 1 to 5 👇

Jesus' first miracle happened at a wedding. 🍷 John 2:1-11

The wine ran out in Cana of Galilee. Mary told the servants, “Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it” (John 2:5). Six stone water jars, filled to the brim, and the governor of the feast said: “thou hast kept the good wine until now” (John 2:10).

What's something God asked you to do before you could see why? 👇

They took a city by walking in circles and shouting. 🎺 Joshua 6

Once a day for six days, they marched around Jericho in total silence. On day seven: seven times around, the priests blew the rams' horns, Joshua said “Shout; for the Lord hath given you the city,” and “the wall fell down flat” (Joshua 6:16, 20).

What's the “day one” you're in right now? 👇
